For fun only."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"A Chrome-dino-style mini-game for DeepSeek Harness Web: while the agent is replying, a progress stri"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"p sits above the input bar (same row as the goal bar) with a play key — click it, run, jump (`Space`"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"/`↑`), duck (`↓`), score from **梁子** toward **梁圣**, and watch the progress bar survive the game and "},{"id":"p6s4","text":"(`↓`), score from **梁子** toward **梁圣**, and watch the progress bar survive the game and every reply."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"> Inspired by Chrome's Dino Run — the offline T-Rex Runner game shipped in the Chrome browser (Chrom"},{"id":"p7s2","text":" Chrome's Dino Run — the offline T-Rex Runner game shipped in the Chrome browser (Chromium project)."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"or GitHub-only:"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Restart `dsh web`, send a message, and press the strip's play key."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## How it plays"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"- **Waiting window**: the strip (and the game once expanded) lives while the session is running; on "},{"id":"p14s2","text":"turn end the game pauses with a brief overlay, then collapses back to the strip.
- **Fold = pause**:"},{"id":"p14s3","text":" clicking the play key (or ×) folds the panel and pauses — expanding again reopens PAUSED; any key o"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"r a click on the surface resumes. Collapsing never resets speed or score.
- **Blur-pause**: focusing"},{"id":"p14s5","text":" the input OR clicking anywhere outside the game panel pauses; keys only control the game while focu"},{"id":"p14s6","text":"s is outside input fields.
- **Speed tiers**: every round (turn) restarts at tier 0, climbing one ti"},{"id":"p14s7","text":"er every 15 s of game time up to tier 4 (1.0/1.2/1.5/2.0/2.5× speed; 1.0/1.2/1.5/2.5/5.0 pts per sec"},{"id":"p14s8","text":"ond — the HUD shows the score rate). Hold the jump key for longer airtime; duck in the air to fall f"},{"id":"p14s9","text":"aster.
- **Obstacles**: cacti/rocks on the ground; low and high flying birds from tier 3 — jump the "},{"id":"p14s10","text":"low ones, duck the high ones.
- **Death**: collision shows a settlement screen — the remaining progr"},{"id":"p14s11","text":"ess to 梁圣 (x%) or the 梁圣 seconds you had survived (x.xxs); **any key** (or a click) restarts. Score,"},{"id":"p14s12","text":" tier and saint status reset on restart.
- **梁圣**: reach the threshold (default 150) and the strip s"},{"id":"p14s13","text":"hows `100% · <seconds>` — surviving seconds **since reaching 梁圣 in this round** (not a lifetime tota"},{"id":"p14s14","text":"s `100% · <seconds>` — surviving seconds **since reaching 梁圣 in this round** (not a lifetime total)."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## Avatar"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"- Built-in default: a stick figure with a DeepSeek-whale face, shipped in `assets/avatars/`.
- Custo"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"m: drop images into `~/.dsh/plugins/dsh-running-liang/avatars/` (created on demand) or upload them f"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"rom **Settings → Plugins → plugin configuration → Liangda Runner**. Pick any avatar there; a missing"},{"id":"p16s4","text":" file falls back to the default."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"In **Settings → Plugins → plugin configuration → Liangda Runner**: `threshold` (梁圣 threshold, defaul"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"t 150), `tierInterval` (seconds per tier, default 15), `allowIdlePlay` (test switch: allow starting "},{"id":"p18s3","text":"the game while the agent is idle), and customizable **jump/duck keys** (jump defaults `Space`, `↑` a"},{"id":"p18s4","text":"lways jumps too; duck defaults `ArrowDown`). The tier table and physics are fixed constants."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## Development"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"Architecture notes: the client registers into the official DSH slots — `conversation.input.dock` (th"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"e strip + growing game panel, same flow as the goal bar) and `settings.plugin.item` (the settings ca"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"rd under Plugins → plugin configuration). The settings-card registration carries the legacy list `id"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"` and the current keyed-slot `key`; the host serves the matching settings namespace so current DSH v"},{"id":"p21s5","text":"ersions can discover the card. The host also registers a `webServer` route `/dsh-running-liang/avata"},{"id":"p21s6","text":"rs` (list / serve / upload). Long-lived state remains in localStorage; avatar files live on disk so "},{"id":"p21s7","text":"they survive browser storage wipes."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## License"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"MIT — see LICENSE."}],"truncated":false}
